description.zh:
Root 操作安全护栏：删除进回收站、修改前备份、幂等还原、环境自检、操作日志；另有落盘判据、违规审计、回收站清单与占用统计。

⚠️ 安装后必须手动启用子包：进入本包详情，打开「Root 安全护栏」子包开关，否则 guard_* 工具不会出现（重启 Operit 也会重新加载）。
description.en:
Safety guardrails for AI-driven root operations: trash-first deletions, pre-modify backups, idempotent restore, environment self-check, operation logs; plus path-policy locate/audit, trash listing and usage stats.

NOTE: After installing, you MUST enable the subpackage manually — open this package's details and turn on the 'Root Guard' subpackage switch, otherwise the guard_* tools will not be registered.

description.zh: 15 个工具：setup / status / init / trash / backup / restore / log / list / tier / locate / audit / config / purge / repair / selftest
description.en: 15 tools: setup / status / init / trash / backup / restore / log / list / tier / locate / audit / config / purge / repair / selftest
